from pathlib import Path
import csv, json, hashlib, subprocess, sys, datetime, collections

repo = Path('/home/mingwei/noc_rtl')
scratch = Path('/tmp/noc-inventory-20261116')
scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024*1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())
def rows(path):
    with path.open() as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))
mesh = repo/'performance/unicast/mesh-traffic'
boundary = repo/'performance/boundary'
specs = []
for p in rows(mesh/'tables/bandwidth.csv'):
    specs.append((mesh, mesh/p['root'], 'mesh-bw', p))
for p in rows(mesh/'tables/latency.csv'):
    specs.append((mesh, mesh/p['run'], 'mesh-latency', p))
for p in rows(boundary/'tables/points.csv'):
    root = boundary/'results'/p['case'].replace('boundary_', '').replace('_', '-')
    specs.append((boundary, root, 'boundary-'+p['kind'], p))
assert len(specs) == 118
inventory, evidence, cohorts, problems = [], [], {}, []
for index, (scene, root, kind, point) in enumerate(specs):
    issues = []
    def check(condition, message):
        if not condition:
            issues.append(message)
    run_dirs = [p for p in (root/'runs').iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    assert len(run_dirs) == 1, str(root)
    run = run_dirs[0]
    record_path = run/(run.name+'.run.json')
    record, validation = read(record_path), read(root/'validation.json')
    summary_path = root/'tables/summary.json'
    tx_path = root/'tables/transactions.json'
    summary, tx = read(summary_path), read(tx_path)
    source = [t for t in tx if t['role']=='source' and t['phase']==1 and t['direction']=='read']
    devices = [t for t in tx if t['role']=='device' and t['direction']=='read']
    manifest_path = root/'provenance/SHA256SUMS'
    source_manifest = sha(manifest_path)
    wave = run/(run.name+'.fsdb')
    wave_sha = sha(wave)
    waveform = record['waveform']
    check(record['passed'] and validation['checker_passed'] and validation['drain'], 'saved_run_status')
    check(record.get('performance_error') is None and validation.get('performance_error') is None, 'performance_error')
    check(source_manifest == record['source_manifest_sha256'], 'compiled_source_manifest_hash')
    check(wave.stat().st_size == waveform['bytes'] and wave_sha == waveform['sha256'], 'actual_FSDB_hash')
    for key in ['waveform_sha256', 'fsdb_sha256']:
        if key in point:
            check(point[key] == wave_sha, 'point_'+key)
        if key in validation:
            check(validation[key] == wave_sha, 'validation_'+key)
    clock = record['clock']['axi_period_ps']
    check(clock == 1000 and record['clock']['noc_period_ps']==1000 and record['clock']['noc_phase_ps']==0, 'clock')
    check(sum(t['useful_bytes'] for t in source)==sum(t['useful_bytes'] for t in devices), 'source_device_bytes')
    check(all(t['first_response_ps']>=t['request_ps'] and t['completion_ps']>=t['first_response_ps'] for t in source), 'timestamp_order')
    endpoints = sorted({t['endpoint'] for t in source})
    counts = collections.Counter(t['endpoint'] for t in source)
    useful_bytes = sum(t['useful_bytes'] for t in source)
    mean_first = sum((t['first_response_ps']-t['request_ps'])/clock for t in source)/len(source)
    pattern = point.get('pattern','')
    condition = point.get('transfer_bytes', point.get('injection_ratio',point.get('load','')))
    if kind=='mesh-bw':
        size = int(point['transfer_bytes'])
        check(len(endpoints)==16 and useful_bytes==16*size, 'wide_workload')
        check(len(source)==16*((size+4095)//4096), 'wide_burst_count')
        check(sha(summary_path)==point['summary_sha256'], 'summary_CSV_hash')
        measured = summary['source_tile_average']['read']['monitor_payload_utilization_percent']
        check(abs(measured-float(point['mean_utilization_percent']))<1e-9, 'BW_value')
    elif kind=='mesh-latency':
        check(len(endpoints)==16 and set(counts.values())=={32} and useful_bytes==4096, 'narrow_workload')
        check(abs(mean_first-float(point['mean_latency_cycles']))<1e-9, 'latency_value')
        if float(point['injection_ratio'])==0:
            outstanding=0
            events=sorted([(t['request_ps'],1) for t in source]+[(t['completion_ps'],-1) for t in source])
            maximum=0
            for time,delta in events:
                outstanding+=delta; maximum=max(maximum,outstanding)
            check(maximum==1 and outstanding==0, 'isolated_zero_outstanding')
    else:
        metrics = read(root/'tables/metrics.json')
        check(len(source)==int(point['transactions']) and useful_bytes==int(point['useful_bytes']), 'boundary_workload')
        first=min(t['request_ps'] for t in source); last=max(t['completion_ps'] for t in source)
        common=(last-first)/clock+1
        check(abs(common-float(point['common_cycles']))<1e-9, 'boundary_common_window')
        for s in metrics['sources']:
            transactions=[t for t in source if t['endpoint']==s['source']]
            mean=sum((t['completion_ps']-t['request_ps'])/1000 for t in transactions)/len(transactions)
            check(abs(mean-s['mean_latency_ns'])<1e-9, 'boundary_source_latency')
            if point['kind']=='read':
                duration=(max(t['completion_ps'] for t in transactions)-min(t['request_ps'] for t in transactions))/clock+1
                util=sum(t['useful_bytes'] for t in transactions)/(64*duration)*100
                check(abs(util-s['bw_util_percent'])<1e-9, 'boundary_tile_util')
        if point['kind']=='read':
            for d in metrics['devices']:
                total=sum(t['useful_bytes'] for t in devices if t['endpoint']==d['memory'])
                check(abs(total/(64*common)*100-d['bw_util_percent'])<1e-9, 'boundary_device_util')
    config_path = root/'config/paper-conditions.json'
    if not config_path.exists():
        config_path = root/'config/preparation.json'
    config = read(config_path)
    address_devices = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for t in devices:
        address_devices[t['addr']].add(t['endpoint'])
    mapping = {}
    for endpoint in endpoints:
        destinations = set()
        for t in source:
            if t['endpoint'] != endpoint:
                continue
            matches = address_devices[t['addr']]
            check(len(matches)==1, 'unique_device_for_source_address')
            destinations.update(matches)
        check(len(destinations)==1, 'fixed_destination_per_source')
        mapping[str(endpoint)] = sorted(destinations)
        x,y=endpoint%4,endpoint//4
        if pattern=='neighbor':
            expected=y*4+(x+1)%4
        elif pattern=='bit_complement':
            expected=15-endpoint
        elif pattern=='transpose':
            expected=4*x+y
        elif pattern=='shuffle':
            q=4*x+y
            expected=2*(q%8)+q//8
        elif pattern=='uniform':
            expected=[6,0,4,0,5,4,11,3,0,7,6,10,3,11,9,2][endpoint]
        else:
            expected=16+y if point['kind']=='read' else 15
        check(destinations=={expected}, 'actual_mapping_'+str(endpoint))
    config_hashes = {p.name:sha(p) for p in (root/'config').iterdir()
                     if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ['.json','.yml','.svh']}
    saved_input_manifest = read(run/'inputs/manifest.json')
    raw = run/'axi-events.csv'
    check(raw.is_file() and raw.stat().st_size>0, 'raw_AXI_events')
    check((run/(run.name+'.log')).is_file(), 'simulation_log')
    check((run/'inputs/manifest.json').is_file(), 'saved_inputs')
    build = Path(record['command'][0]).parent.name
    if source_manifest not in cohorts:
        dut = {}
        for line in manifest_path.read_text().splitlines():
            digest, name = line.split(None,1)
            name = name.strip()
            if name.startswith(('rtl/','define/')):
                p=root/'provenance/source'/name
                check(p.is_file() and sha(p)==digest, 'saved_DUT_source_'+name)
                dut[name]=digest
        cohorts[source_manifest] = dict(build=build,binary_sha256=record['binary_sha256'],
            source_manifest_sha256=source_manifest,representative=str(root.relative_to(repo)),
            waveform=str(wave.relative_to(repo)),run_count=0,dut_files=dut)
    cohorts[source_manifest]['run_count'] += 1
    vcd=run/'interfaces.vcd'
    row=dict(scene=str(scene.relative_to(repo)),kind=kind,pattern=pattern,condition=condition,
        case=run.name,result=str(root.relative_to(scene)),source_tiles=len(endpoints),
        source_transactions=len(source),useful_bytes=useful_bytes,
        build=build,binary_sha256=record['binary_sha256'],source_manifest_sha256=source_manifest,
        fsdb_bytes=wave.stat().st_size,fsdb_sha256=wave_sha,
        existing_interfaces_vcd=vcd.is_file(),
        historical_record_wave_path_exists=Path(waveform['path']).is_file(),
        checks='passed' if not issues else ';'.join(issues))
    inventory.append(row)
    evidence.append(dict(result=str(root.relative_to(repo)),record_sha256=sha(record_path),
        validation_sha256=sha(root/'validation.json'),transactions_sha256=sha(tx_path),
        summary_sha256=sha(summary_path),config_sha256=sha(config_path) if config_path.exists() else None,
        raw_AXI_sha256=sha(raw),config=config,config_snapshot_hashes=config_hashes,
        source_destinations=mapping,input_manifest_seed=saved_input_manifest.get('seed'),
        validation_status=validation.get('offline_calibration_comparison'),
        command=record['command'],stimulus_seed=record.get('stimulus_seed'),
        simulation_seed=record.get('simulation_seed'),clock=record['clock'],issues=issues))
    if issues:
        problems.append(dict(result=str(root),issues=issues))
    if (index+1)%20==0:
        print('Audited',index+1,'runs',flush=True)
output=dict(created_utc=datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z',
    scope='Issue33 step1 inventory; no simulations or new performance metrics',
    branch=subprocess.check_output(['git','symbolic-ref','--short','HEAD'],cwd=str(repo)).decode().strip(),
    head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=str(repo)).decode().strip(),
    working_tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],cwd=str(repo)).decode(),
    script=Path(__file__).read_text(),script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),command=[sys.executable,str(Path(__file__))],
    inventory=inventory,evidence=evidence,cohorts=list(cohorts.values()),problems=problems)
(scratch/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
print('SUMMARY',json.dumps(dict(runs=len(inventory),problem_count=len(problems),
    source_transactions=sum(r['source_transactions'] for r in inventory),
    fsdb_bytes=sum(r['fsdb_bytes'] for r in inventory),
    cohorts=[dict(build=c['build'],runs=c['run_count'],dut_files=len(c['dut_files'])) for c in cohorts.values()])),flush=True)

source_table_check_script:
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json
scratch=Path('/tmp/noc-inventory-20261116')
mesh=Path('performance/unicast/mesh-traffic')
lat=list(csv.DictReader((mesh/'tables/latency.csv').open()))
rows=list(csv.DictReader((mesh/'tables/latency-sources.csv').open()))
checked=0
for point in lat:
 tx=json.loads((mesh/point['run']/'tables/transactions.json').read_text())
 for p in [r for r in rows if r['pattern']==point['pattern'] and r['injection_ratio']==point['injection_ratio']]:
  own=[t for t in tx if t['role']=='source' and t['phase']==1 and t['endpoint']==int(p['endpoint'])]
  mean=sum(t['first_response_latency_ps']/1000 for t in own)/len(own)
  ratio=(len(own)-1)*1000/(max(t['request_ps'] for t in own)-min(t['request_ps'] for t in own))
  assert len(own)==int(p['transfers'])==32
  assert abs(mean-float(p['mean_latency_cycles']))<1e-9
  assert abs(ratio-float(p['actual_injection_ratio']))<1e-9
  checked+=1
assert checked==880
counts={}
for name,key,field in [('sources','sources','source'),('devices','devices','memory')]:
 rows=list(csv.DictReader((Path('performance/boundary/tables')/(name+'.csv')).open()))
 for p in rows:
  root=Path('performance/boundary/results')/p['case'].replace('boundary_','').replace('_','-')
  own,=[r for r in json.loads((root/'tables/metrics.json').read_text())[key] if r[field]==int(p[field])]
  for k,v in p.items():
   if k not in own:continue
   if own[k] is None:assert v=='',(p['case'],k)
   elif isinstance(own[k],(int,float)):assert abs(float(v)-own[k])<1e-9,(p['case'],k)
   else:assert str(own[k])==v,(p['case'],k)
 counts[name]=len(rows)
result=dict(mesh_latency_source_rows=checked,boundary_csv_rows=counts,status='passed')
(scratch/'source-table-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
source_snapshot_method: SHA256 of each saved source file compared with all 148 entries of its own compiled source manifest, for one representative per build
